title: Hahn splits the atom in 1938

tellings.quote: That was um uh happened to be a Nazi scientist by the name of um Han I think uh who did an experiment in 1938 and uh was first uh to split the atom.

plain: In 1938 a German scientist named Otto Hahn did an experiment that was the first to split the atom, the discovery that later led to nuclear weapons. The former Air Force officer Robert Salas tells this from memory, calling Hahn "a Nazi scientist" and adding "I think" about the name, as background to his own story of nuclear missiles and UFOs.
